MoAI-ADK <version> — agentic development kit

Usage: moai <command> [options]
       moai cc|glm|omp -l|-a    lead or agent session

Start
  cc                     Start a Claude Code session
  glm                    Start a Claude Code session on z.ai
                         GLM
  omp                    Start an Oh My Pi (OMP) session
Project
  project-detect         Detect the project's facts
  project-plan           Preview the project profile
  project-apply          Write a previewed project profile
  project-update-plan    Preview the whole project update in
                         one view
  work-flow-plan         Reads only. Print the
                         integration-branch question
                         evidence
  language-setup         Choose the writing language item by
                         item
  language-set           Record the conversation language in
                         HOME
  index-build            Build the code map index
  check-tree             Warn about what the tracked MoAI
                         folders hold

                         and check them

Options:
  -l, --leader
          Start a leader session on the default host (cc);
          the role is entered inside it with `/moai
          --mode-leader`
  -a, --agent [<HOST>]
          Start an agent session on HOST (cc|glm|omp;
          default cc); the role is entered inside it with
          `/moai --mode-agent` (omp: `/skill:moai
          --mode-agent`)
      --color <WHEN>
          Color on a terminal: auto, always (even with
          NO_COLOR or TERM=dumb) or never; put it before the
          command
      --name <NAME>
          Session name (default `leader` for -l, the
          project's next `agent-N` for -a; none without a
          role)
      --model <MODEL>
          Main model (Claude hosts default `opus`)
      --effort <EFFORT>
          Effort (Claude default `medium`)
      --advisor <ADVISOR>
          Advisor model on Claude hosts (fable|opus|sonnet
          or a full claude-* id). None by default; the user
          setting `launcher.advisor` can turn it on. May
          bill to usage credits
      --no-advisor
          Pass no `--advisor` even when the user setting
          `launcher.advisor` turns it on
      --permissions
          Keep permission prompts: no
          `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (Claude hosts).
          Without it a -l|-a session has full access; a
          session without a role never gets a permission
          flag
      --dry-run
          Print the composed command as JSON instead of
          starting the host [aliases: --print-command]
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

Run 'moai <command> --help' for details and examples.
